## Checklist

- [ ] The task acceptance criteria are addressed.
- [ ] The change stays within the approved task scope and avoids unrelated edits.
- [ ] `dotnet restore EtlTool.sln` and `dotnet build EtlTool.sln --no-restore` succeed.
- [ ] Relevant tests succeed, or the reason tests are not applicable is explained.
- [ ] No secret, credential, or connection string is committed.
- [ ] No unnecessary dependency is introduced.
- [ ] User files and test data are preserved where relevant.
- [ ] Codex review is complete.
- [ ] I reviewed the final diff.
